message: Hi Alex, it's Priya at Ironside Auto Care, sounds good, let's do it. How do I pay and when do you start?
reply: Hi Priya, great news! I'll send a secure invoice to this email for the $900 fix pack — payable by card or bank transfer. Once it's paid I'll start within 1-2 business days and keep you posted as I go. I'll also mention the $250/month care plan in the invoice notes if you want ongoing upkeep after the fixes — no pressure either way. Thanks, Priya!
